downloadIntro.zh: 当前版本 v1.55.20。选择与你的电脑匹配的安装包。
downloadIntro.en: The current release is v1.55.20. Choose the installer that matches your computer.

summary.zh: 适用于常见的 Intel 与 AMD 电脑，提供标准安装程序。
summary.en: For common Intel and AMD PCs, delivered as a standard installer.

summary.zh: 适用于 Apple 芯片 Mac，以 DMG 磁盘映像安装。
summary.en: For Apple silicon Macs, delivered as a DMG disk image.

highlights.zh: 矩形、椭圆和三角形画线工具新增「无边框」样式，可仅保留填充区域。
highlights.en: Added a borderless style for rectangle, ellipse, and triangle drawing tools, allowing fill-only shapes.

highlights.zh: 常用图表周期不再限制数量，自定义小时周期统一显示为 H2、H8 等格式；工具栏宽度不足时会自动收纳超出项。
highlights.en: Removed the limit on favourite chart timeframes, standardised custom hourly labels such as H2 and H8, and automatically clips overflow in narrow toolbars.

highlights.zh: 模拟训练、回测、账单和历史交易图表统一周期切换行为：保持 K 线视觉大小、居中时间范围和用户手动缩放。
highlights.en: Unified timeframe switching across practice, backtests, statements, and trade history to preserve candle size, centred time range, and manual zoom.

highlights.zh: 修复大周期 K 线偶发靠右、宽度异常和切换时的残影，同时清理最高价、最低价标记的短暂残留。
highlights.en: Fixed coarse-timeframe candles intermittently aligning right, changing width, or leaving switch artefacts, including stale high/low markers.

highlights.zh: 修复小屏幕下盈亏日历文字溢出和行高被压缩的问题，并优化行情数据页右下角容量统计的布局。
highlights.en: Fixed P&L calendar text overflow and compressed rows on small screens, and refined the market-data size summary layout.

highlights.zh: 托管 Tick 数据入口暂时隐藏，待独立权益兑换与数据目录准备完成后按用户权益开放；本地导入和已有回放能力保留。
highlights.en: Temporarily hid hosted Tick downloads until the dedicated entitlement redemption flow and data catalogue are ready; local imports and existing replay support remain available.
